patterns.note: A large, repeating 'SAY' text graphic in the background rotates and translates along a curved path as the user scrolls, creating a dynamic and branded visual backdrop that contrasts with the static foreground content.

The page utilizes an asymmetric layout, with a dominant, dynamic background graphic occupying the left side of the viewport, while the primary textual content and project list are aligned to the right, creating visual tension and ample negative space.
A high-contrast color scheme features near-black text on a very light off-white background, with a vibrant, almost neon, lime green used exclusively for the large, animated background graphic.
A single, clean sans-serif typeface is used throughout the site, with hierarchy established purely through variations in size and weight, maintaining a consistent and modern typographic voice.

technique_notes: The primary motion effect involves a large, repeating background text element (likely an SVG or styled text) that is animated to rotate and translate along a curved path as the user scrolls down the page. This continuous, dynamic visual backdrop could be achieved using a scroll-triggered animation library to manipulate the transform properties of the background element, creating a parallax-like effect where the background moves independently of the foreground content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Medium-large, bold sans-serif headings (~2-3x body) with clear, legible body text and smaller, uppercase labels for project categories.
design_tokens.spacing: airy in the hero section with significant negative space, transitioning to a balanced density for the project list.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the massive, repeating 'SAY' text graphic that dynamically rotates and moves in the background as the user scrolls. This creates a highly memorable and branded visual experience that is both playful and sophisticated, immediately communicating the site's identity in a unique way.
